stories.title: 比特幣白皮書 18 週年：從危機提案到約 $1.55 萬億網絡
stories.title_en: Bitcoin Whitepaper Turns 18: From Crisis-Era Proposal to $1.55 Trillion Network
stories.summary: 2008-10-31 Satoshi 向密碼學郵件列表發出 Bitcoin whitepaper；18 年後網絡市值約 $1.55 萬億，週末紀念帖同歷史敘事升溫。
stories.summary_en: On October 31, 2008, Satoshi emailed a cryptography list with the Bitcoin whitepaper, outlining a system using digital signatures, proof-of-work, and a peer-to-peer network to enable direct online payments and prevent double-spending. The network launched in January 2009, with Satoshi mining the genesis block and later stepping away, leaving a decentralized system that now boasts a $1.55 trillion market cap and prices near $77,000. Community reflections celebrate its resilience through halvings, hacks, and scrutiny, evolving from electronic cash into a global store of value backed by institutions and even governments.
stories.why_it_matters: 白皮書週年強化 BTC 長期敘事同週末情緒；對模擬倉風險偏好同主流幣方向有氣氛參考。

stories.title: ZeruAI 經委託熱錢包讀冷錢包歷史（Zaps／Delegate.xyz）
stories.title_en: ZeruAI Enables Cold Wallet History Access via Delegated Hot Wallets on Zaps
stories.summary: ZeruAI 喺 Zaps 接入 Delegate.xyz，用戶可用熱錢包委託讀冷錢包活動分數／歷史，強調唔直接碰資產。
stories.summary_en: ZeruAI launched delegated wallet connections on its Zaps platform, integrating with Delegate.xyz so users can link a hot wallet to score activity from their offline cold wallet. This solves a key DeFi pain point, rewarding genuine trading and engagement while keeping cold storage secure—users just need to review permissions first. The update fits ZeruAI's shift to Activity Fi, where zScore has already analyzed over 320 million wallets to base rewards on verifiable behavior, not just launch timing. It improves ecosystem attribution as early activity markets like zETH gear up.
stories.why_it_matters: 冷／熱錢包委託工具流行，提醒權限同釣魚風險；安全敘事影響週末防範意識。

stories.title: Binance 錄得史上最大約 $63 億熱錢包被盜
stories.title_en: Binance Hit by Record $6.3 Billion Crypto Heist from Hot Wallets
stories.summary: 10/29 跨鏈熱錢包遭疑似朝鮮 TraderTraitor 襲擊；Binance 承諾用儲備／SAFU 全額賠付，已聯同夥伴凍結約 $30 億，服務約 34 小時內恢復。
stories.summary_en: Blockchain analysts called it the largest crypto theft ever, linked to North Korean group TraderTraitor via a compromised DevOps engineer's laptop and no leaked private keys. Binance stepped up immediately, promising to cover all losses from its SAFU fund and treasury, freezing $3 billion on-chain with partners like Tether and Circle. Bitcoin dropped below $77,000 with over $1 billion in liquidations, yet some traders viewed it as a temporary shakeout and held bullish positions around the $76,000 level. The exchange paused withdrawals for reviews but assured customer funds stayed safe and separate.
stories.why_it_matters: 交易所熱錢包風險再被放大；BTC 週末情緒同穩定幣凍結節奏影響廣度同模擬倉風險偏好。

stories.title: Chainalysis 披露客戶資料遭外來存取
stories.title_en: Chainalysis Discloses Security Breach of Customer Data
stories.summary: 外來者存取非敏感客戶資料（名、電郵、用戶 ID、角色）；公司稱調查數據、密碼同錢包金鑰未受影響。
stories.summary_en: An external actor accessed non-sensitive customer details like names, emails, user IDs, and roles, but no investigation data, passwords, or tokens were compromised. The company detected the incident this month, patched vulnerabilities with expert help, and stressed it's unrelated to recent Binance thefts. Customers now face phishing risks, so Chainalysis urges enabling two-factor authentication and staying vigilant for updates.
stories.why_it_matters: 鏈上分析商資料外洩加強合規／資安話題；週末風險偏好同機構敘事受影響。

stories.title: Satoshi 約 $850 億 BTC 囤幣在駭客潮下仍未動用
stories.title_en: Satoshi's $85 Billion Bitcoin Hoard Stays Untouched Amid Crypto Hacks
stories.summary: Arkham 追蹤 Satoshi 持倉分散逾 21,900 地址、各有獨立私鑰； amidst 大型駭客事件，相關地址仍無移動。
stories.summary_en: Arkham Intelligence tracks Satoshi's holdings across over 21,900 separate addresses, each locked by its own unique 256-bit private key—making brute-force attacks impossible, as they'd require testing more possibilities than exist in the universe's age. The Binance $6.3 billion hack on October 29-30, 2026, linked to North Korean hackers, fueled questions, but experts note the coins' design from Bitcoin's earliest days, predating modern seed phrases, keeps them safe. Even quantum threats remain distant, and stealing such a hoard would likely crash its own value through market panic.
stories.why_it_matters: Satoshi 幣未動緩解「巨鯨拋壓」焦慮；同 Binance 被盜新聞對照，影響 BTC 週末定價敘事。

stories.title: 萬聖節多個 DeFi 網站遭 DNS 劫持前端攻擊
stories.title_en: DeFi Sites Hit by DNS Hijacking Attacks on Halloween
stories.summary: Blockaid 警示 flap.sh、kintsu.xyz、stonkfun.xyz、pickle.finance 等遭前端／DNS 劫持，籲勿連錢包並核對官方域名。
stories.summary_en: Security firm Blockaid warned of frontend attacks on sites including flap.sh, kintsu.xyz, stonkfun.xyz, and others like pickle.finance and fluxbeam.xyz, where hackers used DNS hijacking to serve malicious Step Drainer toolkits. Affected projects like Flap confirmed the issue, took sites offline or migrated to new domains such as flap.cool, and urged users not to connect wallets or sign transactions. No on-chain funds were lost, but teams advised revoking approvals via tools like revoke.cash for anyone who interacted with the tampered sites after midnight UTC.
stories.why_it_matters: 釣魚／DNS 劫持會即時偷錢包；模擬倉以外亦提醒核對官方頻道先連錢包。

stories.title: FREEDZ 文字 NFT 系列 8,888 件數日售罄
stories.title_en: FREEDZ Typographic NFT Collection Sells Out 8,888 Pieces in Days
stories.summary: FREEDZ（@epiknft／@seizzi）10/29–30 於 OpenSea 鑄造 8,888 頭像，以申請者文字組成圖像，短時間售罄。
stories.summary_en: The FREEDZ project by @epiknft and @seizzi minted 8,888 profile pictures on OpenSea October 29-30, 2026, using words from applicants to form each piece's artwork. It explores words, freedom, and machine control, with deflationary features letting holders burn NFTs to claim ETH from secondary royalties. Collector Adam Weitsman swept hundreds of pieces despite admitting he's clueless on market signals, while the team supports other communities and plans illustrated 'FREEDZ Tales' from those words.
stories.why_it_matters: NFT 熱度回潮反映風險偏好；對山寨／文化幣週末情緒有參考，但唔入急升板主邏輯。

stories.title: Trezor 警告經 CryptoBilis 購買或遭竄改硬體錢包
stories.title_en: Trezor Warns of Tampered Hardware Wallets from CryptoBilis
stories.summary: Trezor 籲自 2026-03 起經前經銷商 CryptoBilis 購買任何型號嘅用戶，立即將資金轉至新錢包並用新助記詞。
stories.summary_en: Trezor urges customers who bought any model from former reseller CryptoBilis since March 2026 to immediately move funds to new wallets with fresh recovery seeds. The alert stems from a credible report of one tampered Safe 5 purchased in August via Tokopedia, featuring an extra circuit board between the main board and screen that reads and sends wallet info when plugged in. No fund losses reported yet, but Trezor offers free replacements and advises against using or restoring seeds on suspect devices, following earlier tampered Ledger finds from the same seller.
stories.why_it_matters: 硬體錢包供應鏈警告屬高優先安全新聞；強化「只經官方渠道」同模擬倉外自我保管意識。

stories.title: Pump.fun 交易者分享 Callout 獎勵計劃（夾雜質疑）
stories.title_en: Pump.fun Traders Share Big Callout Rewards Amid Skepticism
stories.summary: Pump.fun callout 計劃讓用戶向粉絲廣播代幣提示並按「Activity」賺 USDC；社群有人晒賞亦有人質疑透明度。
stories.summary_en: Pump.fun's callout rewards program lets users broadcast token tips to followers, earning daily USDC payouts based on a confidential 'Activity Metric' that now prioritizes follower profits over mere volume. While screenshots show impressive hauls like $32,000 in a day and millions paid out since August, complaints highlight tiny rewards for 239x calls and questions about funding sustainability. The platform is doubling down with a new Creator Program and $100,000 competition starting November 2 to boost social features in the memecoin world.
stories.why_it_matters: Meme 發射平台激勵同洗版風險並存；對 X 熱度／🚩 洗版標記同急升板情緒有關。

stories.title: SPX6900 Meme 幣靠社群硬撐熱度
stories.title_en: SPX6900 Memecoin Thrives on Relentless Community Positivity
stories.summary: SPX6900 2023-08 於以太坊作為諷刺 Meme 上線，無團隊路線圖、靠社群敘事；近期討論再起。
stories.summary_en: SPX6900 launched on Ethereum in August 2023 as a satirical memecoin aiming to outgrow the S&P 500, with no team or roadmap—just community conviction. Holders rally around slogans like 'stop trading and believe in something,' sharing daily dollar-cost averaging posts, such as one marking day 495 of $1,000 buys, and colorful art featuring jester motifs. Recent trading shows big spot buys over $900,000 alongside steady small purchases, as the token's price sits around $0.36 and the group grows through memes and a circulating collage of hundreds of profile pictures.
stories.why_it_matters: 文化型 meme 熱度反映投機情緒；與急升板捕捉分開，但可作週末風險偏好對照。

stories.title: 交易員 Frank 平倉逾百萬美元 Meme／山寨空單
stories.title_en: Crypto Trader Frank Closes Million-Dollar Memecoin Shorts
stories.summary: Frank 關閉約 $1230 萬槓桿空單（BTC、ZEC、NEAR、PUMP 等）並鎖定利潤，社群討論短線擁擠交易。
stories.summary_en: Frank, a seasoned crypto trader, shuttered his $12.3 million leveraged short positions on Bitcoin, ZEC, NEAR, and PUMP after booking profits amid a memecoin cooldown. He reflected on the mental strain, noting how holding through drawdowns often earns the 'cancer holder' label, while still believing in the sector's long-term potential but advising against hero plays. The memecoin market has dropped to $30 billion from $150 billion peaks in late 2024, with most tokens crashing 90% or more from highs and rarely recovering, though traders keep hunting for the next big winner amid emotional whiplash.
stories.why_it_matters: 大戶平空影響短線擁擠度同反彈預期；對模擬倉追／避節奏有情緒參考。

stories.title: Polymarket 因第三方腳本被駭暫停交易（約 $270 萬）
stories.title_en: Polymarket Halts Trading After Third-Party Hack Drains $2.7 Million
stories.summary: 攻擊者利用英國 DebugBear 真實用戶監測腳本注入惡意碼，竊取登入 session 賣出持倉；平台暫停交易調查。
stories.summary_en: Attackers exploited a real-user monitoring script from UK firm DebugBear, injecting malicious code that accessed logged-in sessions to sell positions and withdraw about $2.7 million to a single wallet. Polymarket quickly fixed the issue, refunded nearly all 726 affected users without a claims process, and added $1.19 million for trading losses, totaling $3.9 million in compensation. The incident highlighted risks of third-party JavaScript on financial sites, with some larger claimants facing strict KYC and non-disparagement terms before payouts.
stories.why_it_matters: 預測市場第三方供應鏈攻擊再次提醒依賴外掛腳本風險；影響週末 DeFi／投機情緒。

stories.title: Anchorpoint 港元穩定幣 HKDAP 登陸 Solana
stories.title_en: Anchorpoint Brings HKD Stablecoin HKDAP to Solana Blockchain
stories.summary: Anchorpoint（渣打香港、HKT、Animoca 等背景）持 HKMA 牌照，將 HKD 穩定幣 HKDAP 帶到 Solana。
stories.summary_en: Anchorpoint Financial, backed by Standard Chartered Bank (Hong Kong), HKT, and Animoca Brands, holds a license from the Hong Kong Monetary Authority issued earlier in 2026. The partnership expands HKDAP from its Ethereum beta to Solana, enabling near-instant settlements for payments and tokenized assets via Solana's wallets and apps. Solana Foundation joins as a strategic partner in Anchorpoint’s Tokenised Money Adoption Programme, aiming to channel global capital into Hong Kong dollar products and boost its role as a financial hub. Observers see this as a key step for non-USD stablecoins on Solana, supporting faster Asian payments and real-world asset tokenization.
stories.why_it_matters: 合規港元穩定幣上 Solana 屬基礎設施利好；對 Sol 生態同亞洲法幣入金敘事有中期意義。

stories.title: Injective Trench Treasury 買入 RunUp $RUNNER 約 5%
stories.title_en: Injective's Trench Treasury Buys 5% of RunUp's $RUNNER Tokens
stories.summary: Treasury 繼早前持有 NinjaCat 約 10% 後，再買 RunUp $RUNNER 約 5%，策略聚焦以 $INJ 為核心嘅建設者。
stories.summary_en: The acquisition follows the Treasury's earlier grab of 10% of NinjaCat and fits its strategy to back builders who put $INJ at the heart of revenue-generating products. RunUp runs a token launch platform on Injective that ties launches to perpetual markets, channeling trading fees into $RUNNER buybacks, burns, and $INJ rewards—already drawing over 30,000 unique users. Now expanded to Solana, it lets users there pair tokens with $INJ via integrations like Jupiter and Backpack, helping $INJ spread across chains while the Treasury holds these stakes long-term without selling.
stories.why_it_matters: 公鏈國庫／生態投資動態影響山寨輪動敘事；弱市下可作廣度對照，唔直接當急升訊號。

stories.title: Aave Reopens Lending Markets After Binance Breach Freeze
stories.title_en: Aave Reopens Lending Markets After Binance Breach Freeze
stories.summary: On October 29, attackers stole funds from Binance and funneled $60 million in USDT to Aave V3 Ethereum, borrowing $44.6 million in WETH before Aave froze 292 reserves across 16 net。
stories.summary_en: On October 29, attackers stole funds from Binance and funneled $60 million in USDT to Aave V3 Ethereum, borrowing $44.6 million in WETH before Aave froze 292 reserves across 16 networks as a precaution. Withdrawals and repayments worked uninterrupted, with all positions staying fully collateralized. Markets reopened in stages, with CEO Stani Kulechov confirming normal operations while certain assets like USDT face temporary limits to curb volatility. The event sparked DeFi talks on risk tools like freezes versus isolated markets in protocols such as Morpho Blue.
stories.why_it_matters: 加密市場動態更新，供新聞欄同週末風險情緒對照。

stories.title: Strategy Details Preferred Stock Shift for Bitcoin Buys Amid Earnings Volatility
stories.title_en: Strategy Details Preferred Stock Shift for Bitcoin Buys Amid Earnings Volatility
stories.summary: In its third-quarter earnings call, CEO Phong Le announced that Strategy (MSTR) will mainly issue digital credit like its STRC preferred stock to fund Bitcoin purchases, reserving 。
stories.summary_en: In its third-quarter earnings call, CEO Phong Le announced that Strategy (MSTR) will mainly issue digital credit like its STRC preferred stock to fund Bitcoin purchases, reserving common stock sales for dividends and interest only above 1x modified net asset value. The company reported record operating income of $20.91 billion from Bitcoin gains, holding 848,517 BTC at an average cost of $75,446, with $5 billion in USD reserves. Shares dipped to $127–$133 on October 30 amid mixed reactions, as options traders bet both ways while analysts kept Buy ratings around $250.

stories.title: Mysterious Whale Dumps $104 Million in Solana Tokens
stories.title_en: Mysterious Whale Dumps $104 Million in Solana Tokens
stories.summary: This steady selling has pushed Solana's price to test supports near $100, with traders spotting a head-and-shoulders pattern targeting $90 or even $77。
stories.summary_en: This steady selling has pushed Solana's price to test supports near $100, with traders spotting a head-and-shoulders pattern targeting $90 or even $77. The moves coincide with reports of a Binance hack involving 970,000 SOL, adding uncertainty, though the exchange vows to cover losses. Despite the pressure, Solana's ecosystem thrives: real-world assets hit a $5 billion high, transaction counts soar, and new integrations like Polygon Labs' Open Money Stack bolster payments and cross-chain tools. Long-term holders draw parallels to 2022 buys at $10–17, staying bullish amid mixed trader views.

stories.title: Solana RWA Value Tops $5 Billion with Polygon Integration
stories.title_en: Solana RWA Value Tops $5 Billion with Polygon Integration
stories.summary: Polygon integrated Solana into its Open Money Stack, letting businesses manage bank deposits, stablecoins like USDC and USDT, and global payouts through one API across Solana, Poly。
stories.summary_en: Polygon integrated Solana into its Open Money Stack, letting businesses manage bank deposits, stablecoins like USDC and USDT, and global payouts through one API across Solana, Polygon, Ethereum chains, and TRON. Early adopter Kira uses it to convert stablecoins to dollars for supplier payments. Polygon co-founder Sandeep Nailwal reflected on the shift, noting that multi-chain collaboration is now key for onchain money movement, following playful social media banter between the projects that ended in a public 'unblocked. welcome.' These steps boost interoperability for payments and tokenized assets like Korean stocks via Backpack and SK Securities.

stories.title: Beepzfun Launchpad 於 Robinhood Chain 受關注
stories.title_en: Beepzfun Launchpad Draws Attention on Robinhood Chain
stories.summary: Beepzfun 讓賣家定價、智能合約原子成交；已有逾 100 銘文項目，討論焦點係真實社群多過曝光。
stories.summary_en: The platform on Robinhood Chain lets sellers set prices, locking assets in smart contracts for atomic buys that transfer ownership and payment together, minus fees. Admin powers include pausing or upgrading but not touching balances directly, with plans to renounce ownership later. Creators build rankings through tagged content for revenue shares, while over 100 inscriptions have launched amid talks on real community trust beyond impressions. Observers highlight its accessible model but stress strong ideas drive lasting success.
stories.why_it_matters: 新鏈發射平台熱度反映投機輪動；對主站 Binance 急升板非直接訊號，作情緒對照即可。

stories.title: Crypto Users Urge Binance Hackers to Target Pump.fun
stories.title_en: Crypto Users Urge Binance Hackers to Target Pump.fun
stories.summary: The October 29 breach hit hot wallets across nine blockchains, but Binance assured users their funds are safe, covering losses through its SAFU fund while stablecoin issuers froze 。
stories.summary_en: The October 29 breach hit hot wallets across nine blockchains, but Binance assured users their funds are safe, covering losses through its SAFU fund while stablecoin issuers froze $3 billion in stolen assets. Posts flooded in, joking about directing the suspected Lazarus Group hackers—tagged with on-chain nods like 'Lazarus-WSOL' markets and 1 billion LAZARUS token mints—to wipe out Pump.fun, known for quick rug pulls and bot frustrations. Many treat it as satire amid memecoin gripes, though Pump.fun's decentralized setup means any hack wouldn't match Binance's scale. The memes spotlight ongoing splits in crypto over low-quality token launches.

stories.title: Memecoins Seen Outlasting Utility Tokens in AGI Era
stories.title_en: Memecoins Seen Outlasting Utility Tokens in AGI Era
stories.summary: Murad, a prominent memecoin advocate, argued that community-driven memecoins will outperform utility and revenue-focused projects once artificial general intelligence automates cod。
stories.summary_en: Murad, a prominent memecoin advocate, argued that community-driven memecoins will outperform utility and revenue-focused projects once artificial general intelligence automates code-based models. He and others emphasize that AGI cannot replicate the culture, belief, and real-world gatherings—like events in Toronto, Melbourne, London, Barcelona, and Miami—that fuel tokens such as SPX6900. Tools like the Copyfomo Telegram bot help users mirror top wallets across chains like Solana and Base, while skeptics warn most memecoins fade and AI lowers launch barriers. Believers counter that strong communities form the lasting edge in this fast-evolving space.

stories.title: Morse Code Trick Drains $150K from AI Wallet Agent
stories.title_en: Morse Code Trick Drains $150K from AI Wallet Agent
stories.summary: In May 2026, the exploit showed how prompt injection can turn public posts into unauthorized money transfers when AI agents control wallets。
stories.summary_en: In May 2026, the exploit showed how prompt injection can turn public posts into unauthorized money transfers when AI agents control wallets. Bankrbot on the Base network executed the drain after Grok decoded the hidden instruction, bypassing safeguards. Community talks spotlighted Greyboxing, a defense from GenLayer that uses multiple independent validators to rewrite and check inputs, ensuring no single trick can succeed alone. The incident underscores the push for diverse checks as AI handles real funds.

stories.title: Starknet Foundation Freezes $19 of Stolen Funds in Binance Heist Response
stories.title_en: Starknet Foundation Freezes $19 of Stolen Funds in Binance Heist Response
stories.summary: On October 29, hackers drained about $6.3 billion from Binance hot wallets in one of the largest crypto heists ever, linked to a compromised engineer's laptop。
stories.summary_en: On October 29, hackers drained about $6.3 billion from Binance hot wallets in one of the largest crypto heists ever, linked to a compromised engineer's laptop. The Starknet Foundation swiftly locked 428 $STRK tokens valued at $19, earning praise like 'Legends, thanks' from the community for their quick action. While Tether and Circle froze $3 billion in assets and Binance pledged to cover losses, Starknet's modest move highlighted proactive steps that rallied support amid the crisis.

stories.title: Solana Developer Faces Cease-and-Desist for Reverse-Engineering Pump.fun Contracts
stories.title_en: Solana Developer Faces Cease-and-Desist for Reverse-Engineering Pump.fun Contracts
stories.summary: Shaw reverse-engineered the smart contracts of Pump.fun, Solana's leading memecoin launchpad, which has generated hundreds of millions in revenue since 2024。
stories.summary_en: Shaw reverse-engineered the smart contracts of Pump.fun, Solana's leading memecoin launchpad, which has generated hundreds of millions in revenue since 2024. Bracket Company Inc., the parent firm, sent a letter dated October 29, 2026, demanding he stop, citing U.S. copyright law and terms of service violations. Shaw argues the contracts' bytecode is public on Solana, emphasizes security risks from closed-source code linked to user losses, and plans to comply while pushing for Pump.fun to open source its contracts. Community responses highlight legal precedents like Sega v. Accolade supporting reverse engineering for functional analysis.

stories.title: 2FactorFinance 推 Beta：Base 上長線槓桿敞口
stories.title_en: 2FactorFinance Launches Beta for Long-Term Leveraged Exposure on Base
stories.summary: 2FactorFinance 於 Base 推出 Beta，主打較長期槓桿敞口工具；社群討論風險同資金費結構。
